020import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
021import com.ghostchu.quickshop.common.util.JsonUtil;
022import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
023
024import java.math.BigDecimal;
025import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
026import java.util.Map;
027
028/**
029 * BenefitManager
030 *
031 * @author creatorfromhell
032 * @since 6.2.0.11
033 */
034public interface BenefitProvider {
035
036  /**
037   * Returns a map of benefits associated with each user.
038   *
039   * @return A map where the key is a QUser object representing a user, and the value is a
040   * BigDecimal representing the benefit amount.
041   */
042  Map<QUser, BigDecimal> benefits();
043
044  /**
045   * Indicates whether there are no benefits added.
046   *
047   * @return true if there are no benefits, false otherwise.
048   */
049  default boolean none() {
050
051    return benefits().isEmpty();
052  }
053
054  /**
055   * Checks whether the specified user has a benefit associated with them.
056   *
057   * @param user The user to be checked for benefits. Must not be null.
058   *
059   * @return true if the user has a benefit associated with them, false otherwise.
060   */
061  default boolean hasBenefit(final @NotNull QUser user) {
062
063    return benefits().containsKey(user);
064  }
065
066  /**
067   * Checks whether the given benefit amount will cause an overflow when added to the existing
068   * benefits.
069   *
070   * @param benefit The benefit amount to be checked for overflow. Must be a double value.
071   *
072   * @return true if adding the benefit amount will cause an overflow, false otherwise.
073   */
074  boolean willOverflow(final BigDecimal benefit);
075
076  /**
077   * Adds a benefit percentage to the specified user.
078   *
079   * @param user    the user to add the specified benefit percentage
080   * @param percent the percentage of benefit to add
081   *
082   * @return true if the benefit was successfully added, false otherwise
083   *
084   * @throws BenefitOverflowException if adding the benefit causes an overflow
085   * @throws BenefitsAlreadyException if benefits are already added for the user
086   */
087  boolean add(final @NotNull QUser user, final BigDecimal percent) throws BenefitOverflowException, BenefitsAlreadyException;
088
089  /**
090   * Removes the specified user from this BenefitManager.
091   *
092   * @param user The QUser object representing the user to be removed.
093   */
094  void remove(final @NotNull QUser user);
095
096  /**
097   * Serializes the benefits associated with each user into a JSON string.
098   *
099   * @return A JSON string representation of the benefits map, where the key is a serialized QUser
100   * object and the value is a Double representing the benefit amount.
101   */
102  @NotNull
103  default String serialize() {
104
105    final Map<String, BigDecimal> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
106    for(final Map.Entry<QUser, BigDecimal> entry : this.benefits().entrySet()) {
107
108      map.put(entry.getKey().serialize(), entry.getValue());
109    }
110    return JsonUtil.regular().toJson(map);
111  }
112}
